db:info.db:title: AbstractClass Class
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Test case for private pure virtual methods

db:abstract.db:para: A test class with private pure virtual methods.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: This class demonstrates the corner case of private pure virtual methods. These methods are private but must still be implemented by derived classes.

db:section.db:title: [pure virtual private] void AbstractClass::privatePureVirtual()
db:section.db:para: Private pure virtual method for internal implementation.
This method is private but pure virtual, meaning derived classes must implement it even though it's not publicly accessible. This creates a special case for documentation.

db:section.db:title: [pure virtual private] int AbstractClass::privateVirtualCalculation()
db:section.db:para: Testing multiple private pure virtual methods.

db:section.db:title: [pure virtual protected] void AbstractClass::protectedPureVirtual()
db:section.db:para: This pure virtual method is accessible to derived classes.

db:section.db:title: [pure virtual] void AbstractClass::publicPureVirtual()
db:section.db:para: This pure virtual method is publicly accessible.
